title: PersonaAllocationProposal
description: Standardized proposal from one advisor persona for a capital pool or candidate universe before multi-persona portfolio synthesis.

proposal_id.description: Unique stable identifier for this proposal.

persona_id.description: Advisor persona that produced the proposal.

scope_ref.description: Deployment or universe scope for this proposal, such as paper, canary, live, or a universe reference.

target_type.description: Granularity of the proposed allocation target.

directions.description: Directional hints used by conflict classification and committee escalation.

target_weights.description: Symbol, sleeve, basket, or pool weight map. Semantic validation also requires the sum to be no greater than 1.0.

uncertainty.description: Persona uncertainty estimate; lower values increase fusion weight.

rationale_ref.description: Reference to supporting rationale or memo.

regime_ref.description: Reference to the regime state used by this proposal.

valid_from.description: UTC ISO-8601 start of proposal validity.

valid_to.description: UTC ISO-8601 end of proposal validity. Null means open-ended.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence packet, OODA packet, memo, or audit references supporting the proposal.

created_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the proposal was created.

reliability_score.description: Recent track-record score used by weighted fusion.

regime_fit_score.description: How well this persona proposal fits the current regime.

metadata.description: Governance and normalization metadata, such as asset_classes, strategy_family, strategy_family_risk, first_deployment_in_scope, wants_leverage, or wants_de_risk.
